cart_only_bans.label: Cocoa Beach Sec. 15-47: golf carts only on city streets the commission designates. SR A1A is a state road and is not treated as a cart street (cross where the network map allows).

unverified: The green streets on the 2023 network map are not digitized, so plain golf carts show red except tagged cart paths. SR A1A is banned for carts.

enforcement.note: Golf Cart Maps Greenwich and next-10 research (Oct 28 2026). Posted signs never lift a ban. Designated street lists that are not digitized stay red for plain golf carts.
